# Company device policy

Article 1 Purpose
This policy sets out how employees handle the devices the company lends them.

Article 2 Definitions
In this policy, "Device" means a laptop or a mobile phone that the company lends an employee for work.

Article 3 Lending
The company lends each employee the Devices their work needs.
An employee may not use a Device for anything other than work.

Article 4 Care
An employee looks after a Device with reasonable care.
An employee who loses a Device reports it to IT at once.

Article 5 Return
An employee returns every Device when leaving the company.
An employee need not return a Device that they reported lost under Article 4.

Article 6 Changes
The board of directors decides any change to this policy.
